sheet_from: Data/Item/Eccross.OZT (128x256: violet plate with magenta lines and gold, its alpha cutting 10% away), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py; 324 triangles, one mesh. The .bmd names Eccross.tga, so the .OZT.
cutout_alpha_from: The sheet's own alpha, not its brightness: the paint is dark.
material_note: painted_steel: violet lacquer with magenta and gold lines painted on, as the Dark Phoenix's blue.
chrome_note: Not carried: RenderPartObjectBody (ZzzObject.cpp:7065-7075) draws the one mesh twice more over itself, a violet (0.8, 0, 0.8) lightmap of BITMAP_CHROME sliding along U and a bright BITMAP_CHROME+1 chrome pass, before the body: a violet sheen running over the plate. Nothing here draws an item mesh three times.
